'''Frugatoad''' is a [[Grass]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Frugling]] at 3 bronze stars, and evolves into [[Frugagon]] at 6 bronze stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "The dragon fruit matured, and so Frugatoad must have too...? Not really. This froggy's forever young and on the road."

Frugatoad is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A large, green, frog-like creature with two pointed ears with pink centers, a white underbelly, and large eyes with brown pupils. It has a constant vacant look, and is always drooling. Its dragonfruit is larger than its body now, and has leaves at the base. 

Frugatoad's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces pink with purple, and green becomes neon green. Its pupils also become dark purple.

==Evolution Trial==
Frugatoad's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Frugagon]] you need to complete the following two tasks:

* Feed Frugatoad to increase stats 3 times.
* Reach difficulty 12 in any [[Boss Challenge]].

== Trivia ==

* Prior to the update on 2/10/2026, its bio used to say: "The dragon fruit on its back is too big, so usually Frugatoad just loafs around waiting for lunch."
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Life is like a Frugatoad's back. Until you peel it, you never know if it will be a white or purple dragonfruit---or even a Solpear."
* Prior to the update on 5/13/26 its bio description said: "As the dragon fruit grew bigger, so did Frugatoad's curiosity. Often eavesdrops on conversations before going on to spread whatever has been heard."

==Strategy==
[[File:Frugatoad Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Frugatoad's attack range]]
A very generic Grass DPS, best placed in the back to maximize damage output. Exploding dragonfruit can help clear clusters of enemies.
